words.example_cn: 他把手脚后跟塞进了那个男人的鼻子里。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 heel 和「脚后跟」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: an activity that you like and often do when you are not working
words.example: I like to collect stamps from different countries as a hobby.
words.example_cn: 我喜欢收集来自不同国家的邮票作为一种爱好。
words.tip: 拆词记忆：-y 表示「…的(形)」。整体意思是「爱好；嗜好」。

words.en_def: a place or position
words.tip: 拆词记忆：-tion 表示「…的动作(名)」。整体意思是「地点；位置」。

words.en_def: a design of lines, shapes, colours, etc.
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 pattern 和「图案」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: behaving in a way that is not rude and shows that you think about other people
words.example: It's not polite to use a mobile phone in a restaurant.
words.example_cn: 在餐厅使用手机是不礼貌的。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 polite 和「有礼貌的」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: an answer or reaction to something that has been said or done
words.tip: 拆词记忆：re- 表示「再/重新」。整体意思是「回答；反应」。

words.en_def: a subject that you talk or write about
words.example: A society where a topic cannot be discussed, does not have free speech.
words.example_cn: 一个不能讨论某个话题的社会没有言论自由。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 topic 和「话题」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: to use something that belongs to someone else and then return it to them
words.example: This putt has a big left-to right borrow on it.
words.example_cn: 这个推杆上有一个很大的从左到右的借款。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 borrow 和「借」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: the possibility of choosing between two or more things
words.example: Do I have a choice of what color to paint it?
words.example_cn: 我可以选择涂什么颜色吗？
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 choice 和「选择」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: to stop someone from understanding something
words.tip: 拆词记忆：co- 表示「共同」。整体意思是「使困惑；混淆」。

words.en_def: used when you are giving a choice of two or more things
words.example: I don't like him, and I don't like her either.
words.example_cn: 我不喜欢他，也不喜欢她。
words.tip: 拆词记忆：-er 表示「…的人/物」。整体意思是「或者；两者之一」。

words.en_def: to stay on the surface of a liquid and not go under
words.example: Attach the float and the weight to the fishing line, above the hook.
words.example_cn: 在钓钩上方，将浮标和重物安装到钓线上。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 float 和「漂浮」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: to become covered with water
words.example: a flood of complaints
words.example_cn: 大量投诉
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 flood 和「淹没」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: to direct attention toward something or someone
words.example: The heat of sunlight at the focus of a magnifying glass can easily set dry leaves on fire.
words.example_cn: 放大镜焦点处的阳光热量很容易让干燥的叶子着火。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 focus 和「集中（注意力」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: worried and anxious
words.tip: 拆词记忆：-ous 表示「充满…的」。整体意思是「紧张的；焦虑的」。

words.en_def: looking or being almost, but not exactly, the same
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 similar 和「相似的」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: following or belonging to the customs or ways of behaving that have continued in a group of people or society for a long time
words.example: I think her traditional values are antiquated.
words.example_cn: 我认为她的传统价值观已经过时了。
words.tip: 拆词记忆：-al 表示「…的」。整体意思是「传统的」。

words.en_def: in a voice loud enough to be heard
words.example: Try speaking aloud rather than whispering.
words.example_cn: 试着大声说话，而不是低声说话。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 aloud 和「大声地（出声」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: to talk about a subject with someone and tell each other your ideas or opinions
words.example: I don't wish to discuss this further. Let's talk about something else.
words.example_cn: 我不想再讨论这个问题了。让我们谈谈其他事情。
words.tip: 拆词记忆：dis- 表示「不/相反」。整体意思是「讨论；商议」。

words.en_def: the system for using computers to send messages over the internet
words.example: He sent me his details via email.
words.example_cn: 他通过电子邮件向我发送了他的详细信息。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 email 和「电子邮件」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: to collect several things, often from different places or people
words.example: I've been gathering ideas from the people I work with.
words.example_cn: 我一直在从和我一起工作的人那里收集想法。
words.tip: 拆词记忆：-er 表示「…的人/物」。整体意思是「收集；聚集」。

words.en_def: to ask or request someone to go to an event
words.example: We invited our friends round for dinner.
words.example_cn: 我们邀请了朋友来吃晚饭。
words.tip: 拆词记忆：in- 表示「不」。整体意思是「邀请」。

words.en_def: a type of food made with meat, vegetables, or fruit covered in pastry and baked
words.example: The family had steak and kidney pie for dinner and cherry pie for dessert.
words.example_cn: 一家人晚餐吃牛排和肾馅饼，甜点吃樱桃馅饼。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 pie 和「派」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: feeling pleasure and satisfaction because you or people connected with you have done or got something good
words.example: I am proud of Sivu’s schoolwork.
words.example_cn: 我为Sivu的学业感到自豪。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 proud 和「骄傲的」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: to say or tell people something more than once
words.example: We gave up after the third repeat because it got boring.
words.example_cn: 我们在第三次重复后放弃了，因为它变得无聊了。
words.tip: 拆词记忆：re- 表示「再/重新」。整体意思是「重复；复述」。

words.en_def: the number of vehicles moving along roads, or the amount of aircraft, trains, or ships moving along a route
words.example: The traffic is slow during rush hour.
words.example_cn: 高峰时段交通很慢。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 traffic 和「交通」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: an action that is intended to deceive, either as a way of cheating someone, or as a joke or form of entertainment
words.example: It was just a trick to say that the house was underpriced.
words.example_cn: 说房子定价过低只是个伎俩。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 trick 和「把戏」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a large reptile with a hard skin that lives in and near rivers and lakes in the hot, wet parts of America and China
words.example: All you could see of the alligator were its two eyes above the water, and suddenly it snatched up and caught the poor bird with its strong jaws full of sharp teeth.
words.example_cn: 你所能看到的鳄鱼只有它在水面上的两只眼睛，突然它抓住了那只可怜的鸟，下巴上长满了锋利的牙齿。
words.tip: 拆词记忆：-or 表示「…的人/物」。整体意思是「短吻鳄」。

words.en_def: a lizard that changes skin colour to match what surrounds it so that it cannot be seen
words.example: The wall was covered with a chameleon paint.
words.example_cn: 墙上涂满了变色龙的颜料。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 chameleon 和「变色龙」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a poisonous snake from Africa and southern Asia
words.tip: 拆词记忆：co- 表示「共同」。整体意思是「眼镜蛇」。

words.en_def: a large reptile with a hard skin that lives in and near rivers and lakes in hot, wet parts of the world
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 crocodile 和「鳄鱼」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a type of reptile that became extinct about 65,000,000 years ago
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 dinosaur 和「恐龙」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a small lizard with wide feet, found especially in warm countries
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 gecko 和「壁虎」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a large greyish-green lizard of tropical America
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 iguana 和「鬣蜥」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a small reptile that has a long body, four short legs, a long tail, and thick skin
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 lizard 和「蜥蜴」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a poisonous snake found in southern parts of the US that, when annoyed, produces a loud noise by shaking its tail
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 rattlesnake 和「响尾蛇」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: an animal with a thick, hard shell that it can move its head and legs into for protection
words.tip: 拆词记忆：-ise 表示「使…化」。整体意思是「乌龟；陆龟」。

words.en_def: any of a number of laterally compressed deep-bodied fish with extended dorsal and anal fins, typically brightly colored or boldly striped
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 angelfish 和「神仙鱼」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a fish with a flat head and long hairs around its mouth that lives in rivers or lakes
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 catfish 和「鲶鱼」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a small fish that is usually red, orange, or yellow with white stripes, and lives in warm or tropical seas
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 clownfish 和「小丑鱼」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a large sea fish that can be eaten
words.example: I assume it all could just be a cod.
words.example_cn: 我想这一切都可能只是一只鳕鱼。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 cod 和「鳕鱼」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: any of a number of brightly colored marine fish with a parrotlike beak, which they use to scrape food from coral and other hard surfaces
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 parrot fish 和「鹦鹉鱼」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a medium-sized silver-coloured fish that lives in the sea or rivers and swims up rivers to produce its eggs
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 salmon 和「三文鱼」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a small sea fish that can be eaten
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 sardine 和「沙丁鱼」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a large, long fish that is often eaten as food, with a very long pointed part like a beak at the front of its head
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 swordfish 和「剑鱼」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: a fish that lives in rivers and lakes, or lives in the sea but returns to rivers to produce its eggs
words.example: Many anglers consider trout to be the archetypical quarry.
words.example_cn: 许多垂钓者认为鳟鱼是典型的采石场。
words.tip: 联想记忆：把 trout 和「鳟鱼」多读几遍，结合例句印象更牢。

words.en_def: to express the most important facts or ideas about something or someone in a short and clear form
words.example: Jim was asked to summarize the document by Wednesday.
words.example_cn: Jim被要求在周三之前对文件进行总结。
words.tip: 拆词记忆：-ize 表示「使…化」。整体意思是「总结；概括」。
